description: Read-only. List the SHARED Sedis-owned reference zones — the same for every key, with NO tenant filter (these are not your private data). Each row exposes its `sedisId`, `name`, and `sourceName` (the external-reference provider, e.g. 'Nils Holgersson'). Use a reference zone as a market benchmark to compare against your own comparison zones and property units. Example: nameContains 'Stockholm'. Shared reference data; read-only — never writes.

sort.description: Comma-separated sort fields; prefix '-' for descending, e.g. '-name'.
